dct_description_sm: "Lambert conformal conic projection." North sheet without series note. Elevations are shown by hachures and spot heights in meters. Two classes of roads and five classes of railroads are shown. Inset on each sheet shows area with detailed transportation information. Scale 1:1,500,000. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image.
